ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution showing approximately 60% high-intensity (white) pixels and 40% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric fields centrally located on both lobes, bifurcated by a dark central column; thick black peripheral margins along the leading and trailing edges with significant dark pixel infiltration in the form of mottling and streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute-angled V-shaped depression at the central convergence point dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge, with more pronounced jagged peaks localized on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave curvature near the tips transitioning to a convex curve as it approaches the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized white circular clusters (barnacle attachment points) on the far-left lobe tip and secondary yellowish-brown circular spots on the inner right medial surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white regions of both lobes in multiple orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) visible across the majority of both lobes; physical irregularity and jagged tissue loss on the leading edge of the left lobe tip.
